Alyssa Spellman was here! I love Sophie to death. ♥

My name is Sophie and i'm fifteen.
My phenomenal horses name is Biggs and hes fifteen too!
Biggs is an OTTB and I leased him for over two years until I finally bought him on April 15 of 2011! 
My trainer recently discovered that his hips are out of line so I moved him to her barn where he is seeing an amazing chiropractor and hopefully I will be able to jump him and even show him again very soon!
